node.title: Re^6: How can I access package variables in a dynamic way
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Agreed... although this is really moving into "hack" territory, my code from [id://1229810|here] could be extended to:

my $amax; for ($amax=1; exists $Person::{"address_$amax"}; $amax++) {} $Person::addresses = sub{\@_}->( map { no strict 'refs'; ${"Person::address_$_"} } 1..$amax-1 );
